frozenDependencies: accepted palace macro silhouette and all macro transforms
approved palace facade and all facade transforms
main dome and satellite dome dimensions
requiredFeatures: Three visibly different honeycomb scales: large inhabited window cells, medium structural cell bands, and sparse small trim cells. The hierarchy must never become uniform wallpaper.
Large and medium cells use thick gold structural frames over dark recessed sockets so they read as dimensional architecture from both front and three-quarter views.
The lower cathedral body, central keep, and four satellite tower bodies each receive occupied honeycomb windows with warm amber inner glow on front, side, and rear-facing surfaces.
The hero dome receives coherent gold longitudinal ribs and at least one latitude collar that follow the dome instead of floating above it; satellite domes use a simpler subordinate rib family.
Filigree floor collars and corner ribs unify the cathedral tiers while preserving the approved stepped silhouette and keeping the royal door, rose window, and four facade bays unobstructed.
At least four warm palace lamps and one dominant bee crest/royal emblem survive the phone overview.
All ornament embeds into or closely seats on its owning surface with no floating sockets, z-fighting, rear discontinuities, or accidental intersections.

scaleLanguage.heroCells: 0.24-0.34 world-unit radius; sparse occupied bays and facade anchors
scaleLanguage.structuralCells: 0.13-0.21 world-unit radius; tier and tower rhythm
scaleLanguage.trimCells: 0.07-0.11 world-unit radius; only on collars, crown, or selected seams

phoneRead: Door and rose window remain focal points one and two.
Honeycomb structure is unmistakable without dissolving into visual noise.
Dark recess, edible amber glow, and pale-gold rib contrast survive the overview camera.
Hero dome remains dominant over all satellite ornaments.

rose window, royal door, stairs, or banners obscured
dome ribs reading as detached hoops

more than one correction within this construction family

capture.gate: All required categories at least 0.85. The user-accepted palace-macro drift does not waive ornament quality.
